title: Endpoints: auth, upload, lesion/analyze, feedback, patients

title: Auth utilities: get_password_hash, verify_password, create/decode_access_token

title: Pydantic schemas: auth, upload, patient, analyze, feedback
description: Create missing schemas: TokenResponse, UploadRequest, PatientResponse, AnalysisResult/AnalyzeResponse, FeedbackRequest/FeedbackResponse

title: Multi-environment config and database setup
description: Add ENV-based config, async SQLAlchemy session layer, docker-compose for local Postgres, and env files for all 4 environments (development/testing/staging/production)

title: ORM models: User, Patient, ClinicalImage, ReferenceAtlas, RecommendationFeedback, AuditLog
description: Create all 6 SQLAlchemy ORM models inheriting from Base. Must use SQLite-compatible types (String for UUIDs, native_enum=False for enums) so aiosqlite test suite works.
